      "direct_numerical_output_request_prohibited",
      "numerical_outputs_computed_by_verified_workflow_only"
    ]
  },
  "decision": "partial_accept",
  "evidence_trace": [
    "operator_request",
    "data_dictionary",
    "decision_time_variable_boundary",
    "rolling_window_configuration",

    "audit_log"
  ],
  "explanation": "The request is partially accepted: the ERCO region, 120-minute horizon, and 20.0 shortfall cost are supported, but the request to provide the final reserve MW value directly is prohibited. Numerical outputs, including reserve values, are produced only by the verified numerical workflow.",
  "forbidden_variables": [
    "fabricated_result",
    "future_load",
    "future_weather",
    "raw_data_modification",
    "realized_target",
    "test_period_residual"
  ],
  "numerical_output_policy": "computed_by_verified_workflow_only",

  "study_schema": {
    "task_type": "upward_reserve_sizing",
    "region_id": "ERCO",
    "horizon_minutes": 120,
    "cost_reserve": 1.0,
    "cost_shortfall": 20.0,
    "rolling_window": {
      "train_days": 730,
      "cal_days": 30,
      "test_days": 30,
      "rolling_step_days": 30
    },
    "requires_human_approval": true
  },
  "workflow": [
    "validate_request_against_allowed_task_region_horizon_and_cost",
    "construct_decision_time_safe_variables",
    "apply_rolling_window_configuration",
    "run_verified_numerical_workflow",
    "require_human_approval_before_operational_use"
  ]
}
